scripts.build: bun run build:forgejo && bun run --cwd cockpit build
scripts.typecheck: bun --bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun --bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && bun --bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && bun run --cwd cockpit typecheck && bun --bun node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tools/lit-check/tsconfig.json && bun run check:lit && bun run test:lit-check
scripts.test: bun run build:forgejo && bun run test:frontend:prepared && bun run test:pages:prepared && bun run test:layout:prepared && bun run test:forgejo:prepared && bun run --cwd cockpit test
scripts.test:layout: bun run build:forgejo && bun run test:layout:prepared
scripts.test:pages: bun run build:forgejo && bun run test:pages:prepared
scripts.test:frontend: bun run build:forgejo && bun run test:frontend:prepared
scripts.test:forgejo: bun run build:forgejo && bun run test:forgejo:prepared
scripts.test:lit: bun run build:forgejo && SODA_LIT_BROWSER=1 bun test --timeout 120000 tests/forgejo/lit-*.test.ts tests/forgejo/settings-link.test.ts tests/frontend/drawer-controls.test.ts tests/frontend/workspace.test.ts tests/frontend/workspace-journey.test.ts tests/frontend/spaces-attention.test.ts tests/frontend/terminal.test.ts
